repository.name: Auth Service
repository.description: Internal authentication service providing versioned token APIs.

files.content:
# Auth Service

Auth Service provides Auth API v2 at `POST /v2/auth`. AUTH-900 removed the former v1 production route on 2026-10-01. Consumers must use the v2 scoped-token contract.

commits.message: AUTH-900 remove Auth API v1 production route

pull_requests.title: AUTH-900 Remove the v1 authentication route
pull_requests.description: Deletes POST /v1/auth from the production router. POST /v2/auth remains the supported authentication contract.
